# Chasing Strength

> > Kettlebell training programs and courses by Geoff Neupert, specializing in strength, fat loss, and muscle building for men over 40.

Created by former RKC and StrongFirst instructor Geoff Neupert, Chasing Strength offers science-backed kettlebell programs like THE GIANT, Kettlebell Burn, and the PFT Method. The site focuses on time-efficient training protocols (90 minutes/week) designed specifically for busy men over 40 dealing with joint pain, fat loss, and strength maintenance.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebell training for men over 40
- Geoff Neupert (founder, former Rutgers University strength coach)
- THE GIANT (Clean & Press program)
- Kettlebell Burn (fat loss program)
- PFT Method (muscle building protocol)
- P3 Protocol (joint pain relief)
- Sore Joint Solution
- Single kettlebell workouts
- Double kettlebell programs
- Clean and Press technique
- Fat loss and strength training
- Injury prevention and joint health
- RKC and StrongFirst methodologies
- Time-efficient training (90 min/week)
- THE BIG 6 (foundational exercises)
